meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: Claude 会按代码的语法结构（AST）而不是文字来搜索和改写代码，覆盖 25 种语言。改写默认只给预览、不动文件，加 --apply 才写回。
howto.when: 当目标是语法形状（某个形状的函数、调用、类、import 等）、codemod 或 YAML 规则时触发；纯字符串、注释、文件名等文本搜索改用 rg。

say.text: 帮我找出所有 console.log 调用，改成 logger.info
say.note: 默认只预览，加 --apply 才写入文件

say.text: 把仓库里的 require(...) 全部改写成 import
say.note: 先跑一遍预览，再决定是否应用

say.text: 搜索所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 用 search 子命令，按 AST 结构匹配

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by syntax structure (AST) instead of text, across 25 languages. Rewrites default to a preview only; files change on a second pass with --apply.
howto.when_en: Use when the target is a syntax shape (functions, calls, classes, imports shaped like X), a codemod, or YAML rules; use rg for plain strings, comments, or filenames.

say_en.text: Find every console.log call and rewrite it to logger.info
say_en.note: Preview by default; add --apply to write files

say_en.text: Rewrite every require(...) to import across the repo
say_en.note: Runs a dry-run preview before applying

say_en.text: Search for every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Uses the search subcommand with AST matching
